  AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2018-06-01'
GROUP BY s.seller_zip_code_prefix

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  s.seller_city,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.shipping_limit_date >= '2017-01-01' AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2018-01-01' THEN i.price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2017,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.shipping_limit_date >= '2018-01-01' AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2019-01-01' THEN i.price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2018,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.shipping_limit_date >= '2017-01-01' AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2018-01-01' THEN i.price ELSE 0 END) > 0
    THEN (
      SUM(CASE WHEN i.shipping_limit_date >= '2018-01-01' AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2019-01-01' THEN i.price ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN i.shipping_limit_date >= '2017-01-01' AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2018-01-01' THEN i.price ELSE 0 END)
    ) * 1.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN i.shipping_limit_date >= '2017-01-01' AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2018-01-01' THEN i.price ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS growth_rate
FROM order_items i
JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = i.seller_id
GROUP BY s.seller_city
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN i.shipping_limit_date >= '2018-01-01' AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2019-01-01' THEN i.price ELSE 0 END) >= 5000
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  s.seller_state,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM i.shipping_limit_date) >= 21 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS late_ratio,
  AVG(i.price) AS avg_price,
  COUNT(*) AS item_count
FROM order_items i
JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = i.seller_id
WHERE i.shipping_limit_date >= '2018-04-01'
  AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2018-07-01'
GROUP BY s.seller_state
ORDER BY late_ratio DESC;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  t.seller_state,
  COUNT(*) AS seller_count,
  SUM(t.revenue) AS total_revenue,
  AVG(t.revenue) AS avg_revenue_per_seller
FROM (
  SELECT
    s.seller_state,
    i.seller_id,
    SUM(i.price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items i
  JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = i.seller_id
  WHERE i.shipping_limit_date >= '2017-01-01'
    AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY s.seller_state, i.seller_id
) t
GROUP BY t.seller_state
ORDER BY avg_revenue_per_seller DESC;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  s.seller_city,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id) AS unique_products,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS unique_orders
FROM order_items i
JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = i.seller_id
WHERE i.shipping_limit_date >= '2018-09-01'
  AND i.shipping_limit_date < '2018-10-01'
GROUP BY s.seller_city
ORDER BY unique_products DESC, unique_orders DESC
LIMIT 10;
